resolution: The morning after, Pei came to the ward gate and asked Tang about the old man who had knocked. Tang told him: a physician from the West Market, and that he had sat the night out at the gate. Whether the door opened for him that night is still not known; the house knows who he is either way.
summary: The Geng side door opened as Xu Ping left the lane at curfew. He did not look back and does not know whether he was seen.
